mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 77 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Harriet Park under a new moon phase.

The city is preparing for the fall elections with various notices now posted. Also, please note that road construction begins August 18 on Highway M, shifting traffic and closing the driveway near Alliant and Kwik Trip.

There is plenty to do, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market today at Hometown Junction Park and Trivia Night at The Mill this evening. Looking ahead, you can enjoy Concerts in the Park tomorrow at Century School Park.
In our weekly report, we noted an incident on August 5 where a man was arrested on Whalen Road for a probation violation warrant after attempting to flee from officers.
Caramel Peanut Buttercup is the flavor of the day at Culver's, and they are open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by.
